verdict.rationale: Linear documents building agents in-product: Loops let users describe a job in plain language and set it to run on a schedule or on an event, the changelog says you can "build agents" for incidents, SLAs or feedback, and users can share skills. A developer Agents platform also lets custom agents be delegated issues and @mentioned. However, these are recurring workflows on top of Linear Agent rather than a fully configurable custom agent. Missing for 10: configuration of agent persona, tools or model within the product; detailed docs on the agent-building flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product

citations.quote: Build agents that can investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback.
Describe the job in plain language and then choose whether it should run on a schedule or in response to an event.
We now support sharing skills with your team so great personal workflows can become shared team process.
Once connected to Linear, teammates can delegate issues to your agent or mention it in comments.
